He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball|Saint Louis Billikens]]. ==High school career== French grew up in [[Middletown, New York]] and did not play organized basketball until eighth grade, instead playing [[running back]] on youth league football teams. After a five-inch growth spurt, he was noticed by [[Middletown High School (New York)|Middletown High School]] coach Jim Kelly and joined the team in eighth grade, helping the team become the Class AA section 9 champions. French transferred to [[Springfield Commonwealth Academy]] following his freshman year. As a senior, he had 38 points, 18 rebounds and 10 assists against [[Brewster Academy]].{{cite news |last1=Durando |first1=Stu |title=Built like a tight end, French pursues basketball dream at SLU |url=https://www.stltoday.com/sports/college/slu/built-like-a-tight-end-french-pursues-basketball-dream-at/article_52d92325-584a-57db-a378-fd96d5d62e59.html |accessdate=April 11, 2020 |work=[[St. Louis Post-Dispatch]] |date=October 27, 2017}} He led the team to winning the Hoophall Classic, defeating [[Cushing Academy]] 61–56. French finished with 10 points and 17 rebounds and was named MVP.{{cite news |last1=Chiarelli |first1=Mark |title=Hasahn French, Malik Pouncy lead Springfield Commonwealth Academy to comeback Hoophall Classic win (photos/video) |url=https://www.masslive.com/hoophallclassic/2017/01/hasahn_french_malik_pouncy_lea.html |accessdate=April 11, 2020 |work=[[MassLive.com]] |date=January 16, 2017}} A four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], French committed to playing college basketball for [[Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball|Saint Louis]] over [[UMass Minutemen basketball|UMass]] and [[UNLV Runnin' Rebels basketball|UNLV]]. ==College career== As a freshman, French averaged 9.3 points and 7.1 rebounds per game and set a Saint Louis freshman record with 59 blocked shots.{{cite news |last1=Durando |first1=stu |title=Three Billikens picked for A-10 preseason teams |url=https://www.stltoday.com/sports/college/slu/three-billikens-picked-for-a--preseason-teams/article_0a559aed-33b0-5070-a576-f15b0df1ec1d.html |accessdate=April 11, 2020 |work=[[St. Louis Post-Dispatch]] |date=October 18, 2018}} French was named to the [[Atlantic 10 Conference|Atlantic 10]] All-Rookie Team.{{Cite news|url=http://www.atlantic10.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=31600&ATCLID=211704410|title=Aldridge, Adams Named Atlantic 10 Co-Players of the Year, Rhode Island's Hurley Voted as Coach of the Year|work=Atlantic10.com|access-date=April 11, 2020}} In the first round of the 2019 Atlantic 10 Tournament, French scored 22 points and had 12 rebounds in a win over [[Richmond Spiders men's basketball|Richmond]].{{cite news |last1=Hochman |first1=Benjamin |title=Hochman: With a new haircut and same defensive tenacity, SLU's shot-stuffing French is 'The Stifle Tower' |url=https://www.stltoday.com/sports/columns/benjamin-hochman/hochman-with-a-new-haircut-and-same-defensive-tenacity-slus-shot-stuffing-french-is-the/article_073a61da-b23e-5728-a1e2-2288a252ddc4.html |accessdate=April 11, 2020 |work=[[St. Louis Post-Dispatch]] |date=October 28, 2019}} As a sophomore, French averaged 9.3 points, 8.4 rebounds, and 1.8 blocks per game on a team that finished 23–13 and reached the NCAA Tournament. He was named to the Third Team All-Atlantic 10 as well as the Defensive Team.{{cite news |last1=Stevens |first1=Patrick |title=#A10MBB PREVIEW: Billikens' Core, Freshman Provide Bright Future |url=https://atlantic10.com/news/2019/10/30/mens-basketball-a10mbb-preview-billikens-core-freshman-provide-bright-future.aspx |accessdate=April 11, 2020 |work=Atlantic10.com |date=October 30, 2019}} On November 23, 2019, French scored 21 points and pulled down an Atlantic 10 record-tying 24 rebounds in a 60–55 win against [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont]].{{cite news |title=French scores 21 to carry Saint Louis past Belmont 60–55 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401170143 |accessdate=April 11, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 23, 2019}} He was named to the midseason [[Karl Malone Award]] watchlist.{{cite news |last1=Miller |first1=Corey |title=SLU star Hasahn French named to 2020 Karl Malone Award watch list |url=https://www.ksdk.com/article/sports/college/slu/slu-basketball/slu-star-hasahn-french-named-2020-karl-malone-award-watch-list/63-44d9a48c-62e6-4f1e-8020-716415f7d007 |accessdate=April 11, 2020 |work=KSDK |date=February 6, 2020}} As a junior, French averaged 12.4 points, 10.4 rebounds, 2.3 assists and 2.6 blocks per game.{{cite news |title=Billikens’ French and Goodwin will enter NBA Draft but may return |url=https://www.foxsports.com/midwest/story/saint-louis-billikens-hasahn-french-jordan-goodwin-nba-draft-033120 |accessdate=April 11, 2020 |work=[[Fox Sports]] |date=March 31, 2020}} He led the conference in rebounding and became Saint Louis's all-time leader in blocks.{{cite news |last1=Miller |first1=Corey |title=Four Billikens earn All-Conference honors for SLU |url=https://www.ksdk.com/article/sports/four-billikens-earn-all-conference-honors-for-slu/63-cd7a24e6-e342-40a4-acee-1c25931ca46b |accessdate=April 11, 2020 |work=KSDK |date=March 10, 2020}} French was named to the Second Team All-Atlantic 10 as well as the Defensive Team.{{cite news|url=https://atlantic10.com/news/2020/3/10/toppin-named-atlantic-10-player-of-the-year-grant-voted-coach-of-the-year.aspx|title=Toppin Named Atlantic 10 Player of the Year, Grant Voted Coach of the Year|work=Atlantic10.com|access-date=March 10, 2020}} Following the season, he declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite news |last1=Miller |first1=Corey |title=SLU forward Hasahn French declares for NBA Draft |url=https://www.ksdk.com/article/sports/college/slu/slu-basketball/slu-forward-hasahn-french-declares-nba-draft/63-0d0701b0-609f-4ce7-a152-e363c9da962c |accessdate=April 11, 2020 |work=KSDK |date=March 31, 2020}} On June 3, French withdrew from the draft and opted to return for his senior season.{{cite news |last1=Miller |first1=Corey |title=SLU forward Hasahn French joins teammate Goodwin in withdrawing from NBA Draft, returning for senior season |url=https://www.ksdk.com/article/sports/college/slu/slu-hasahn-french-withdraws-nba-draft-senior-season/63-9aec0bec-214b-46d1-bb98-0b7b8bde5355 |accessdate=August 2, 2020 |work=KSDK |date=June 3, 2020}} He averaged 9.2 points and 7.4 rebounds per game as a senior.{{cite news |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=NCAA Division I men's college basketball rosters, departures, newcomers for 2021-22 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31357458/ncaa-division-men-college-basketball-rosters-departures-newcomers-2021-22 |access-date=June 20, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=June 17, 2021}} ==Professional career== On June 25, 2021, French reportedly signed his first professional contract with [[G.S. Lavrio B.C.|Lavrio]] of the [[Greek Basket League]].{{cite web |last1=Mammides |first1=Chris |title=French starts his pro career at Lavrio |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Greece/news/690831/French-starts-his-pro-career-at-Lavrio|publisher=[[Eurobasket.com]] |accessdate=June 25, 2021 |date=June 25, 2021}} However, the transfer never fully materialized. On August 19, he signed with [[KK Krka|Krka]] of the [[Premier A Slovenian Basketball League|Slovenian League]].{{cite web |last1=Markovic |first1=Rado |title=American Hasahn French joins Krka frontcourt |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/ABA-League/news/700798/American-Hasahn-French-joins-Krka-frontcourt |website=Eurobasket |access-date=August 19, 2021 |date=August 19, 2021}} For the 2022–23 season, French joined the [[Raptors 905]] of the [[NBA G League]],{{cite web |title=Raptors 905 select Daniels and French in G League Draft |url=https://raptors905.gleague.nba.com/news/raptors-905-select-daniels-and-french-in-g-league-draft |website=[[NBA G League]] |access-date=26 March 2023 |date=26 October 2022}} however he did not make the final roster. On 2 December 2022, French was announced as a new signing for the [[Newcastle Eagles]] of the [[British Basketball League]].{{cite web |url=https://newcastle-eagles.com/news/eagles-add-french/ |title=Eagles add French |website=newcastle-eagles.com |access-date=26 March 2023 |date=2 December 2022}} On October 28, 2024, French joined the [[Delaware Blue Coats]],{{cite tweet|author=Delaware Blue Coats|title=ready for camp.🫡 #GetYourCoatsOn|number=1850954040386986467|user=blue_coats|date=October 28, 2024|access-date=November 3, 2024}} but was waived on November 4.{{cite
